name: isAdicRing_iff_completeSpace_and_t2Space
statement:
theorem isAdicRing_iff_completeSpace_and_t2Space [UniformSpace R] [IsUniformAddGroup R]
    {I : Ideal R} (hI : IsAdic I) :
    IsAdicRing I ↔ CompleteSpace R ∧ T2Space R

name: FormalSpectrum.basicOpen_mul
statement: theorem basicOpen_mul (f g : R) : basicOpen I (f * g) = basicOpen I f ⊓ basicOpen I g

name: FormalSpectrum.basicOpen_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basicOpen_one : basicOpen I (1 : R) = ⊤

name: FormalSpectrum.basicOpen_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basicOpen_zero : basicOpen I (0 : R) = ⊥

name: FormalSpectrum.comap_mk_toThickening
statement:
theorem comap_mk_toThickening (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (x : FormalSpectrum I) :
    PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n)) (toThickening I n hn x) =
      toPrimeSpectrum I x

name: FormalSpectrum.continuous_map
statement: theorem continuous_map (φ : R →+* S) (h : I ≤ J.comap φ) : Continuous (map I J φ h)

name: FormalSpectrum.exists_basicOpen_eq
statement:
theorem exists_basicOpen_eq (g : R ⧸ I) :
    ∃ f : R, basicOpen I f = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g

name: FormalSpectrum.isClosedEmbedding_toPrimeSpectrum
statement: theorem isClosedEmbedding_toPrimeSpectrum : IsClosedEmbedding (toPrimeSpectrum I)

name: FormalSpectrum.isHomeomorph_toThickening
statement:
theorem isHomeomorph_toThickening (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    IsHomeomorph (toThickening I n hn)

name: FormalSpectrum.isTopologicalBasis_basicOpen
statement:
theorem isTopologicalBasis_basicOpen :
    TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis
      (Set.range fun f : R => (basicOpen I f : Set (FormalSpectrum I)))

name: FormalSpectrum.ker_factor_le_nilradical
statement:
theorem ker_factor_le_nilradical (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    RingHom.ker (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_self hn : I ^ n ≤ I)) ≤
      nilradical (R ⧸ I ^ n)

name: FormalSpectrum.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : map I I (RingHom.id R) (Ideal.comap_id I).ge = id

name: FormalSpectrum.mem_basicOpen
statement:
theorem mem_basicOpen (f : R) (x : FormalSpectrum I) :
    x ∈ basicOpen I f ↔ Ideal.Quotient.mk I f ∉ x.asIdeal

name: FormalSpectrum.range_toPrimeSpectrum
statement:
theorem range_toPrimeSpectrum :
    Set.range (toPrimeSpectrum I) = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set R)

name: FormalSpectrum.thickeningHomeomorph_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem thickeningHomeomorph_apply (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (x : FormalSpectrum I) :
    thickeningHomeomorph I n hn x = toThickening I n hn x

name: FormalSpectrum.toPrimeSpectrum_map
statement:
theorem toPrimeSpectrum_map (φ : R →+* S) (h : I ≤ J.comap φ) (x : FormalSpectrum J) :
    toPrimeSpectrum I (map I J φ h x) = PrimeSpectrum.comap φ (toPrimeSpectrum J x)

name: FormalSpectrum.toThickening_image_basicOpen
statement:
theorem toThickening_image_basicOpen (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (f : R) :
    toThickening I n hn '' (basicOpen I f : Set (FormalSpectrum I)) =
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) f) :
        Set (PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ I ^ n)))

name: FormalSpectrum.toThickening_preimage_basicOpen
statement:
theorem toThickening_preimage_basicOpen (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (f : R) :
    toThickening I n hn ⁻¹'
        (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) f) : Set (PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ I ^ n)))
      = (basicOpen I f : Set (FormalSpectrum I))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.algEquiv_germ_eq_sectionValue
statement:
theorem algEquiv_germ_eq_sectionValue (g : A) (W : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top A))
    [IsLocalization.Away g
      (((Spec.structureSheaf A).presheaf.obj (op W) : Type u))]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum.Top A) (hp : p ∈ W) :
    ((IsLocalization.algEquiv p.asIdeal.primeCompl
        ((Spec.structureSheaf A).presheaf.stalk p)
        (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)).toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
      ((Spec.structureSheaf A).presheaf.germ W p hp).hom) =
      sectionValue W p hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.isUnit_germ_iff_isUnit_value
statement:
theorem isUnit_germ_iff_isUnit_value (g : A) (W : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top A))
    [IsLocalization.Away g
      (((Spec.structureSheaf A).presheaf.obj (op W) : Type u))]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum.Top A) (hp : p ∈ W)
    (t : (Spec.structureSheaf A).presheaf.obj (op W)) :
    IsUnit (((Spec.structureSheaf A).presheaf.germ W p hp).hom t) ↔
      IsUnit (sectionValue W p hp t)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.sectionValue_algebraMap
statement:
theorem sectionValue_algebraMap (W : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top A)) (p : PrimeSpectrum.Top A)
    (hp : p ∈ W) (a : A) :
    sectionValue W p hp (algebraMap A _ a) = algebraMap A _ a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.sectionValue_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sectionValue_apply (W : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top A)) (p : PrimeSpectrum.Top A)
    (hp : p ∈ W) (t : (Spec.structureSheaf A).presheaf.obj (op W)) :
    sectionValue W p hp t = t.1 ⟨p, hp⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.sectionValue_res
statement:
theorem sectionValue_res (W W' : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top A)) (i : W' ⟶ W)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum.Top A) (hp : p ∈ W')
    (t : (Spec.structureSheaf A).presheaf.obj (op W)) :
    sectionValue W' p hp (((Spec.structureSheaf A).presheaf.map i.op).hom t) =
      sectionValue W p (leOfHom i hp) t

name: IsAdic.exists_pow_le
statement: theorem exists_pow_le (hI : IsAdic I) (hJ : IsAdic J) : ∃ n : ℕ, J ^ n ≤ I

name: IsAdic.le_radical
statement: theorem le_radical (hI : IsAdic I) (hJ : IsAdic J) : J ≤ I.radical

name: IsAdic.radical_eq
statement: theorem radical_eq (hI : IsAdic I) (hJ : IsAdic J) : I.radical = J.radical

name: IsAdic.range_toPrimeSpectrum_eq
statement:
theorem range_toPrimeSpectrum_eq (hI : IsAdic I) (hJ : IsAdic J) :
    Set.range (FormalSpectrum.toPrimeSpectrum I) =
      Set.range (FormalSpectrum.toPrimeSpectrum J)

name: IsAdic.toPrimeSpectrum_homeomorphFormalSpectrum
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toPrimeSpectrum_homeomorphFormalSpectrum (hI : IsAdic I) (hJ : IsAdic J)
    (x : FormalSpectrum I) :
    FormalSpectrum.toPrimeSpectrum J (hI.homeomorphFormalSpectrum hJ x) =
      FormalSpectrum.toPrimeSpectrum I x

name: IsAdic.zeroLocus_eq
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_eq (hI : IsAdic I) (hJ : IsAdic J) :
    PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set R) = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set R)

name: CommRingCat.isUnit_of_forall_isUnit_π
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_forall_isUnit_π (hc : IsLimit c) (x : c.pt)
    (h : ∀ j : J, IsUnit (c.π.app j x)) : IsUnit x

name: Localization.awayQuotientEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem awayQuotientEquiv_algebraMap (x : R ⧸ K) :
    awayQuotientEquiv f K (algebraMap (R ⧸ K) (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk K f)) x)
      = algebraMap (R ⧸ K) (Localization.Away f ⧸ K.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f))) x
